notes.title: 「Version 1.1.6」Update: Introducing the NG+ Chapter Select Hub!
notes.notes:
Hi Pocket Mirror Fans,

The Winter holidays are here, and we hope you are having a wonderful time with your loved ones. We also hope that all the work we've put into Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum will help make it even better!

With this update, we are adding a huge new feature: The New Game+ Chapter Select Hub. Now instead of restarting at the beginning, you can choose to restart the beginning of any chapter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958569/4371ee20f2f12a139bd4057401939768091be88b.png[/img]
Additionally, we've worked to fix several bugs that were still popping up in the game.
[list]
[*] implemented NG+ Chapter Select Hub
[*] fixes to legacy art portraits
[*] minor spelling errors
[*] fixed videos played from extras menu stuck in dark screen when replayed after skipping
[*] Attemptrd to fix crashes that could be related to slower computers
[*] added more time to load at the start of Cerberus map which sometimes causes an error for some players
[*] changed death scene trigger in mirror maze that sometimes causes an error for some players
[/list]Thanks for being our fans, and we hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: 「Version 1.1.5」Update
notes.notes:
Hi Pocket Mirror fans,

We strive to improve the overall experience, and we understand the hassle of choosing the language each time the game launches. To make things easier, the language selection will only appear once at the beginning, and you can switch to another language from the settings from now on.

What's more, except for implementing some minor fixes, we've also added Mac support to this "Version 1.1.5." There is more to come, and we hope you will like it.

The update details are as follows:
[list]
[*] Fixed certain lines in Russian and Italian that didn't show up in the prologue
[*] Fixed Enjel's portrait artifacts and sewn mouth expression that wasn't showing correctly
[*] Fixed a typo in Harpae's Extra Room Dialogue
[*] Language Selection only appears once and can be switched in the settings menu
[*] Added Mac support
[/list]
Cheers,

notes.title: 「Version 1.1.4」Update
notes.notes:
Hi Pocket Mirror fans,

We have been paying close attention to all the reported issues and have fixed and implemented as many as possible in the newest update, "Version 1.1.4." We are always improving the game to make it enjoyable to all players, and hope this update can resolve most of the known issues.

The update details are as follows:
[list]
[*] Minor fixes for character sprites getting stuck in certain frames
[*] Minor dialogue and text formatting fixes
[*] Fixed potential softlock in opening new game+ door
[*] Fixed certain charms reappearing when reloading the save file
[*] Fixed charm position in new game+ that wasn't supposed to be accessed in the normal game
[*] Fixed some minor collisions
[*] Updated character portraits
[*] Fixed some sprite artifacts
[*] Fixed the bug where some objects re-moving when exiting and re-entering the room
[*] Removed the need to talk to pumpkins in the bloody ballroom for achievement - they are technically 'same ones' as the normal ballroom ones
[*] Updated localization in Gallery and Settings menu
[*] Updated Korean localization
[*] Added FPS fix to avoid issues like 300 FPS
[*] Updated Opening Video with higher quality one
[/list]
Cheers,

notes.title: Demo Update！
notes.notes:
Hi Pocket Mirror fans,

We hope everyone is enjoying the game so far!

We are happy today to announce that the demo now supports the same language as the game, making it possible for people from various countries to enjoy it in their own language too.

Supported languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Japanese
[*] Simplified Chinese	
[*] Traditional Chinese	
[*] French	
[*] Italian	
[*] German	
[*] Spanish - Spain	
[*] Korean	
[*] Russian	
[*] Spanish - Latin America	
[/list]
Tell your friends to try out the free demo!

Cheers,

notes.title: 「Version 1.1.3」Update
notes.notes:
Hi Pocket Mirror fans,

We hope everyone is enjoying the game so far! 

This game can be difficult at times, and we understand the frustration of rewatching the death animation over and over again. In the newest update, "Version 1.1.3," you are now able to skip the death animation by clicking the button. 

As usual, we also have fixed several bugs reported by the communities and will continue to improve the overall experience for everyone.

The update details are as follows:
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of resetting config data / global save data
[*] Fixed minor spelling errors / character dialogue names
[*] Fixed character portrait graphical artifacts
[*] Fixed minor issues to character sprites
[*] Added confetti to replace pumpkin charm in Rose Labyrinth pumpkin interaction when the charm has already been collected
[*] Added ability to skip game over video
[*] Update to video loading for videos not loading for some players
[*] Updates/fixes for localization
[/list]
Cheers,

notes.title: 「Version 1.1.2」Update
notes.notes:
Hi Pocket Mirror fans,

We are sorry for being unable to resolve the "fonts/GenRyuMin-R.ttc" issue that some users are experiencing through the last update. With "version 1.1.2," we decided to replace the font with an already-working one, which should solve all the problems.

We also have fixed several bugs reported by the communities and will continue to improve the overall experience for everyone.

The update details are as follows:

[list]
[*] Replace the current Chinese font that has been giving some players issues with loading
[*] Language fixes/update
[*] Fixed an infinite pumpkin charm glitch
[*] Minor fixes with collision and pathing
[*] Fixed Save Volume BGM Bug
[*] Resized some Gallery Images
[*] Fixed softlock at the beginning of Chapter 2 
[*] Fixed a softlock at Chapter 5
[*] Fixed Graphic glitch in Chapter 4
[*] Commentary pumpkin position in Chapter 4
[/list]
Cheers,

notes.title: 「Version 1.1.1」Update
notes.notes:
Hi Pocket Mirror fans,

We have just released a hotfix, "Version 1.1.1," to address a few issues in "Version 1.1." 

The video preloading function that we implemented in the previous "Version 1.1" update seems to prevent some users from playing the video properly and is causing an error. We have reverted the function, and the videos should be playing as usual.

In the meantime, we've implemented another fix to address the "Failed to Load fonts/GenRyuMin-R.ttc" issue. If you still have the same issue after the update, please try manually installing the following font to your computer directlty.  (Select all fonts -> Right Click -> Install) 

Directory: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Pocket Mirror - Goldenertraum\fonts
Font name: GenRyuMin-R.ttc

The update details are as follows:

[list]
[*] Reverted the video preloading function to eliminate errors
[*] Changed Chinese font settings to prevent fail loading
[/list]

Cheers,

notes.title: 「Version 1.1」Update
notes.notes:
Hi Pocket Mirror fans,

We want to thank everyone's patience and are sorry for not being able to provide the promised language options on day 1. The technical issues have been resolved, and with the "Version 1.1" update, we are glad to announce that we are bringing back the languages and fixing some bugs reported by the community.

The update details are as follows:

[list]
[*] Activated the following remaining language options with proper linebreaks
     - French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Korean
[*] Changed Chinese font settings to prevent fail loading
[*] Adjusted Font Sizes for Chinese Prompts.
[*] Fixed achievement for "Normal End No. 3 ~ Little Goody Two Shoes"
[*] Added video preloading
[*] Fixed text overflowing issue in multiple languages
[*] Fixed minor collision bugs in the library
[/list]
Some tips to Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum
1/ You can switch between full-screen and windowed modes by pressing "F4."
2/ You can speed up the dialog by pressing "Shift." (it works on the beginning splash screen as well)
3/ Looking for the PDF booklet for the soundtrack? It's in the following folder
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\music\Pocket Mirror - Goldenertraum - OST

We are keen to provide everyone the best experience with this beautiful remastered. We are aware there are some outstanding reported issues, and we will address them ASAP. If you ever find any other issues, whether about the language or some bugs, please don't hesitate to share them with us.

We hope everyone can enjoy this game as much as we do!

Cheers,
